verdict.rationale: BILL ships specific built-in automations that run in the background once configured: vendor autopay pays automatically when a bill is created, the Invoice Coding Agent codes multi-line bills, custom approval policies route approvals, and spend is auto-categorized for compliance. Webhooks and APIs are only building blocks and earn no credit here. These are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a user-defined automation builder, and several are AP-centric rather than Spend & Expense. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation or rule builder for Spend & Expense, documentation on how to configure and monitor autonomous agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
